The current state of HEAD has these issues:
1. **Attractions-section function** (line ~174) uses `for (i, item) in items.enumerate()` which doesn't work in typst 0.14.0 (enumerate() not supported on arrays). Fix: change to `for (i, item) in items.enumerate()` → manual index loop: `let i = 0 for item in items { ... i = i + 1 }`. Also change parameter `items: ()` to just `items` (positional).

2. **Gallery call sites** (lines ~530-980): they use `gallery: attractions-section(accent: C-X, items: (...))` — this causes "unclosed delimiter" errors because named args with array content don't work. Fix each one: change to positional items: `gallery: attractions-section((title: "...", copy: "..."), (title: "...", copy: "..."), (title: "...", copy: "..."), accent: C-X)`

3. **Em dashes** in copy blocks cause issues. Replace all `—` (U+2014) with `-` (hyphen).

4. **Image paths**: `images/beitou.jpg` → `images/beitou-library.jpg`, `images/ximending.jpg` → `images/ximending-redhouse.jpg`, `images/jiufen.jpg` → `images/jiufen-lanterns.jpg`, `images/zoo.jpg` → `images/taipei-zoo.jpg`, `images/leofoo.jpg` → `images/beitou-library.jpg` (use existing image)

5. **Function signature change**: the `attractions-section` function signature at line ~174 currently has `items: ()`. Change to just `items` (positional first parameter).

Steps to fix:
1. Read the file
2. Replace all em dashes with hyphens
3. Fix the image paths
4. Change the `attractions-section` function signature from `items: ()` to `items`
5. Change the `attractions-section` for loop from `for (i, item) in items.enumerate()` to manual index loop
6. For each of the 7 gallery call sites (search for `gallery: attractions-section`), change from named `items: (...)` to positional items. The pattern is:
   - OLD: `gallery: attractions-section(accent: C-X, items: ((title: "...", copy: "..."), (title: "...", copy: "..."), ...))`
   - NEW: `gallery: attractions-section((title: "...", copy: "..."), (title: "...", copy: "..."), ..., accent: C-X)`
7. Compile with `typst compile taipei-trip-en.typ taipei-trip-en.pdf` to verify
8. If there are compile errors, fix them and recompile
9. The file should compile to `taipei-trip-en.pdf` successfully

Important notes:
- The `attractions-section` function at line ~174 currently takes `items: ()` and uses `items.enumerate()`. The `enumerate()` method does NOT work on arrays in typst 0.14. You must use a manual index loop.
- The `attractions-section` function also takes `items` as a NAMED parameter (`items: ()`). In typst 0.14, named parameters with array content cause "unclosed delimiter" errors. You must change it to POSITIONAL.
- After changing the function to positional, ALL call sites must pass items positionally.
- Do NOT use Python scripts that modify the file - use the Edit tool (StrReplace equivalent) for precise text replacements
- After each change, verify the file compiles
</user_query>
